Control Question: Briefly describe the solution and how Harbor staff will use it.
Attach your latest SOC 2 Type II report (or HITRUST certification) and bridge letter if the period ended more than 3 months ago.
Does the solution support SAML 2.0 single sign-on with the customer's IdP? Is SCIM provisioning supported?
Describe encryption of Harbor data in transit and at rest (algorithms / key management).
Date and summary of the most recent independent penetration test; status of high/medium findings.
How is privileged/administrative access to production restricted and reviewed?
Describe your incident response plan and the timeframe in which Harbor will be notified of a security incident or breach.
Will the vendor create/receive/maintain/transmit PHI on Harbor's behalf? Will the vendor sign Harbor's Business Associate Agreement?
Describe how PHI is minimised or de-identified before processing by any AI model.
List all subcontractors/subprocessors that may access PHI and confirm each has a BAA (or equivalent) with the vendor.
Confirm all Harbor data (including backups and logs) is stored and processed only within the United States.
State retention periods for ticket content, prompts/outputs and application logs.
Is Harbor data used to train or fine-tune models (yours or a third party's)?
Describe how outputs are evaluated for accuracy and how hallucinations are surfaced to users.
Provide RTO/RPO and date of last DR test.
Provide certificate of cyber liability insurance (min $5M).
